# Week 1 — Vectors (demo slides)

## Slide 1: What is a vector
A vector is an ordered list of numbers, e.g. v = (2, 1). Geometrically: an arrow from the origin.

## Slide 2: Linear combinations
a·v + b·w for scalars a, b. The set of all combinations is the span.

## Slide 3: Dot product
u · v = Σ uᵢ vᵢ. In the notation of this course: ⟨u, v⟩.
